statement.name: getIssuesForApplication
statement.sql:
select cast(a.IssueId as varchar(36)) IssueId, IssueTrackingNo, IssueTypeCode, ResponsibleUserId, IssueTitle, IssueDescription, RestrictsFundingFlag, Phase,c.Createddate,d.FirstName, d.LastName, b.ResourceValue,b.ResourceTypeCode from IssueContext a inner join IssueContext b on a.issueId=b.IssueId inner join Issues c on a.issueid = c.issueid inner join lu_users d on c.responsibleuserid = d.userid
11
order by c.Createddate desc

statement.name: getProcessInstance
statement.sql:
select cast(fpi.process_instance_id as varchar(36)) as id, object_id as IssueId, cast(fpi.process_definition_id as varchar(36)) as processDefinitionID, cast(fpi.root_process_instance_id as varchar(36)) as rootInstanceID, fpi.current_state_id as state, fpi.container_xml as containerXML, fpi.client_status_msg as clientStatusMsg from FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpi inner join PROCESS_INSTANCE_CONTEXT pic on fpi.process_instance_id = pic.process_instance_id
6
order by fpi.client_status_msg
